turns.question: How many page views did customers make on our site on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no page-view count; the closest metric is Site sessions (sessions with a page view), which was 5 sessions on 1 October 2026 (a one-day figure). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
